title: How to Use Your Apps With Fewer Taps
summary: With pop-up menus and widgets, your phone or tablet gives you quick ways to check information and get things done with less effort.
caption: As shown on an iPad, pressing an icon just long enough for a menu to pop up can often give you shortcuts to certain actions within that app. Some apps also include widget options at the top of the menu that you can use to add a mini-version of the app to the screen.

title: A Man in Denver Has Been Throwing Eggs at Waymo Vehicles
summary: The man, who drove a Toyota Corolla from a fleet leased to Lyft drivers, used orange cones to trap the self-driving vehicles before pelting them with eggs, the police said. No charges have been filed.
caption: A Waymo vehicle driving in Denver last month. The company started its driverless service in the city in September.
